plans.idea: Faithful wide translation of the original: logo top-left, big two-line headline with subhead in a left column, NEW VIDEO tag anchored under the copy on the same left edge, and the bottle large on the right where the cream circle sits.
Editorial eyebrow structure: the NEW VIDEO tag sits as a kicker above the headline, the copy fills the left column, and the logo signs off at the bottom-left, with the bottle on the right.
Product-tag grouping as in the original: the NEW VIDEO tag sits top-right above the bottle so tag and product read as one unit, while the logo heads a taller left copy column that runs top to bottom.
